gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-athiti: Expressive, Funnel Display runs spaghetti-like strokes of uniform width. Athiti, a sans-serif with a high mean line, is sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, and that shared uniform stroke is the real bond.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-atkinson-hyperl: Funnel Display draws its spaghetti-like letters with the line weight of a technical drawing pen, expressive and commanding. Atkinson Hyperlegible reads steadily over many lines, its wide-set s terminals and clipped capitals keeping each word distinct.

Spaghetti-thin strokes, all one width, give Funnel Display its look. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans-serif spaced like stretched stencil bridges, moves through paragraphs at a measured pace while its counters breathe.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-biryani: Same-width, spaghetti-like strokes define Funnel Display. Biryani, with large-eyed e's and no stroke modulation, shares that uniformity yet feels friendlier, its small counters unclogged beside the heading's commanding gestures.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-blinker: Spaghetti strokes, all one width, and plenty of attitude. Blinker, a sans with open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height, keeps the page readable while Funnel Display makes the noise.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-carrois-gothic: Pencil-line strokes, all one consistent width, give Funnel Display a loose, expressive swagger that Carrois Gothic never tries to copy. One makes statements; the other, with its high x-height, simply reads.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-carrois-gothic-: Carrois Gothic SC keeps a clear opening at the end of every curve and holds capitals and lowercase level. Funnel Display matches that with outlines free of calligraphic swelling, and the shared flatness is what ties them.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-chivo: Commanding up front, Funnel Display keeps every stroke the same width. Chivo, a sans with lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight through every curve, would carry paragraphs with a sturdy, friendly rhythm.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-chocolate-class: Funnel Display traces every glyph with a single thickness, expressive and commanding. Chocolate Classical Sans, with a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, reads comfortably across paragraphs.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-comme: Flat letters, loud personality. Funnel Display handles the commanding spaghetti-like strokes up front, while Comme, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, keeps reading smooth.
